## Serious espresso. Plus auto milk.

Like professional machines, the Bambino Plus can deliver third wave specialty coffee. This is made possible by the 4 keys formula. Delivering barista quality performance using a 54mm stainless steel portafilter with 18 grams of coffee for full flavor and a powerful hands-free automatic steam wand that makes microfoam milk for you ready for latte art. With a proprietary ThermoJet heating system the machine is ready to start in 3 seconds.

Learn more about third wave specialty coffee.

## Experience third wave specialty coffee at home, made possible by the 4 keys formula

Our espresso machines are designed to use the right dose of freshly ground beans, ensure precise temperature control, optimal water pressure and create true microfoam milk essential for latte art. You're only a touch away from getting the 4 keys formula used by professional cafe machines.

## ThermoJet® heating system

Digitally printed heating circuit, up to 44.3% more energy efficient when compared to a Thermoblock heating system*. Fast heat up achieves the optimum extraction temperature in seconds. * Based on internal benchmark testing as of September 2026.

## Auto and manual milk with powerful 266°F steam for easy silky microfoam

Enjoy silky, velvety microfoam milk automatically with 3 adjustable milk temperatures and 3 levels of texture. Or hands on manual texturing like a barista.

## 54 mm stainless steel portafilter delivers full flavor with dual and single wall filters

Full bodied coffee with rich and complex flavors is created using the ideal dose of 18g of freshly ground beans delivered by a professional style 54mm stainless steel portafilter.

## Low pressure pre-infusion followed by 9 bar extraction

An opulent, creamy and caramel colored espresso starts with low pressure pre-infusions, followed by a high pressure (9 bar) extraction process delivered via our 15 bar Italian pump.

## Simple interface with volumetric shot control

Convenient one-touch 1 & 2 shot volumetric control and steam.

## Compact Footprint for all countertops

Big in performance, yet small in size the Bambino Plus will feel at home in any kitchen.

# Breville Bambino® Plus Espresso Machine

## Frequently Asked Questions

- 1. What is low-pressure pre-infusion for the Breville Bambino® Plus Espresso Machine?

The Breville Bambino® Plus Espresso Machine starts by wetting the grounds with low, steady water pressure before full extraction to gently expand them for a more even extraction.

- Pressure gradually increases before extraction.
- Designed to support balanced flavor and thick crema.
- 2. Can the Breville Bambino® Plus Espresso Machine create microfoam for latte art?

Yes, it has automatic microfoam texturing that produces barista-quality froth for making latte art.

- The hands-free frothing system produces light and billowy microfoam.
- A stainless-steel swivel steam wand froths milk for lattes and cappuccinos.
